_readme: EVERYTHING the owner may need to change lives in this one file. No code editing required. Anything marked CONFIRM is a placeholder/assumption waiting for the owner. Keep the JSON valid (use a JSON validator if unsure).

contact._emailNote: Public email shown on the site (optional). Where enquiry emails are DELIVERED is set in .env (OWNER_EMAIL).

location.addressOneLine: 3rd Floor, Basant Central, Mills & Godown Area, beside Trends, Hirasingh Bagan, Sakchi, Jamshedpur, Jharkhand 831001, India
location.landmark: 3rd Floor, Basant Central, beside the Trends showroom, Sakchi
location.mapQuery: Aroma Multicuisine, 3rd Floor, Basant Central, Hirasingh Bagan, Sakchi, Jamshedpur 831001
location._geoNote: CONFIRM: paste the exact latitude/longitude from Google Maps (right-click the pin). Until then the 'geo' block is left out of the SEO data rather than guessed.
location._placeIdNote: CONFIRM: Google Place ID (needed for the live reviews widget + the direct 'Write a review' link).
location._parkingNote: CONFIRM: parking details (e.g. 'Basement parking at Basant Central'). While null, the AI concierge sends parking questions to WhatsApp instead of guessing.

hours._note: Set a day to null (e.g. "mon": null) to mark it closed. Times are 24-hour, Asia/Kolkata.

busyNote.en: Weekends 8–10 PM are our busiest hours — please book ahead.
busyNote.hi: सप्ताहांत में रात 8–10 बजे सबसे ज़्यादा भीड़ रहती है — कृपया पहले से बुक करें।

toggles._note: true = show, false = hide. 'buffet', 'social', 'showPrices', 'onlineOrdering' and 'birthdayWall' stay OFF until the owner confirms the details below / provides content.

buffet._note: CONFIRM all three, then set toggles.buffet = true.

_alsoNote: Paste each listing URL. A badge without a URL is shown as a plain label (no dead links).
_offersNote: Today's Special / offer banner. Example: [{"id":"sunday","text":{"en":"Sunday family special","hi":"रविवार फैमिली स्पेशल"},"until":"2026-12-31"}]. Empty = no banner. Never publish an offer that is not confirmed.

_signatureNote: Dish names come from guest reviews. 'spice' (1–3) is the TYPICAL heat for that style of dish — CONFIRM with the kitchen. 'diet' is null for dishes that exist in both veg and non-veg versions or are unconfirmed (no marker shown). Add "photo": "<image-id>" to a dish once a real photo of that exact dish exists.
